## Offline changes

- Copied the original HTML, CSS, JavaScript, image, and audio trees as local runtime dependencies.
- No remote runtime script, font, statistic, iframe, or top-level redirect was found in the selected files; the upstream footer attribution links were flattened to local text.
- No new game implementation was introduced.

## Known risks

- The MIT notice covers the upstream project, while the aircraft, space, image, and audio assets should be checked for separate third-party rights.
- The ranking/game state behavior is inherited from the upstream browser implementation and may depend on local browser storage.
